component.alias: Heat & Glo Cosmo 32,Heat & Glo Cosmo 36,Heat and Glo Cosmo,IntelliFire,IntelliFire Touch,IFT-WFM,Quadra-Fire IntelliFire,Vermont Castings IntelliFire,Majestic IntelliFire,Hearth and Home IntelliFire
component.notes:
Heat & Glo Cosmo 42 gas fireplace with the IntelliFire Wi-Fi module (IFT-WFM).
IMPORTANT - THIS PROFILE REQUIRES A COMPANION BRIDGE ==================================================== This profile does NOT talk to the fireplace directly. It talks to the "intellifire-bridge" helper that ships alongside it.
The reason is authentication. Every command the IntelliFire module accepts on its local API must be signed with a two-round SHA-256 challenge/response:
payload = "post:command=<cmd>&value=<val>" inner = SHA256(api_key_bytes + challenge_bytes + payload_bytes) response = SHA256(api_key_bytes + inner)
A Savant component profile can append CRC-16, XOR, Fletcher and similar checksums, but it has no SHA-256 primitive, so it cannot sign these commands. The bridge (stdlib-only Ruby, runs on the Savant host under launchd) does the signing and exposes a plain HTTP interface this profile can drive.
Status polling alone (GET /poll on the fireplace) needs no authentication, so a read-only profile would have been possible - but a fireplace you can watch and not control is not worth having.
TESTED WITH: ============ - Heat & Glo Cosmo 42 with IntelliFire Wi-Fi module (IFT-WFM) - intellifire-bridge 0.1.0 - Savant da Vinci 11.2.1
SETUP REQUIREMENTS: =================== 1. The IntelliFire Wi-Fi module must be installed, joined to your 2.4 GHz network, and working in the IntelliFire phone app.
2. Give the fireplace a static IP (DHCP reservation).
3. Install intellifire-bridge on the Savant host and run "bin/intellifire-credentials" once to fetch the API key and user id from iftapi.net. That is the only time the cloud is involved; everything after it is local.
4. Set this component's IP address in Blueprint to the host running the bridge (the Savant host itself if you followed the default install), and leave the port at 4568 unless you changed INTELLIFIRE_BRIDGE_PORT.
5. Generate Services. The Fireplace appears as a Trigger Controlled Device with On/Off. Flame height, fan, thermostat, timer and the rest are custom actions you can place on a UI screen or drive from workflows/scenes.
6. OPTIONAL - for slider control, add Lighting entities in the data table: Address1 = 1 -> Flame Height (0-100 slider maps to flame level 0-4) Address1 = 2 -> Accent Light (0-100 slider maps to light level 0-3) Address1 = 3 -> Blower (0-100 slider maps to fan speed 0-4)
SAFETY NOTE: entity 1 puts the flame on a Lighting service, which means whole-house lighting scenes and "turn on the lights" voice commands can ignite the appliance. Add it only if you want that. Entities 2 and 3 control accessories and are harmless.
ARCHITECTURE NOTES: =================== Every bridge endpoint - polls and commands alike - answers with the same flat JSON status document, so this profile needs exactly one parser (the FireplaceStatus status_message) rather than per-command response blocks.
The document is deliberately flat: scalars only, no nested objects, no arrays, no JSON booleans. Flags arrive as 0/1 integers and the error list arrives pre-collapsed into a string, because Savant's root_object JSON parser addresses values by simple path.
The bridge also holds an optimistic overlay for a few seconds after a command, so the status fetched 1.5 s later already reflects the new value even though the appliance's own /poll has not caught up.
Bridge endpoints used here: GET /status - full status document GET /power/on|off - ignite / extinguish GET /flame/0..4|up|down - flame height GET /fan/0..4|up|down - blower speed GET /light/0..3|up|down - accent light GET /dimmer/<1|2|3>/<0-100> - percent control, shape of Savant's DimmerSet GET /thermostat/f/<degF> - thermostat setpoint (also c/, raw/, up, down, off) GET /timer/<minutes> - auto-off timer, 0-180 (also /timer/off) GET /pilot/on|off - standing pilot GET /beep, /soft_reset - locate chirp, clear soft lockout
